# Workbook routes that stay on FastAPI (plan 04). One "METHOD /path/{param}" per line.
# Go must not register them; infra/nginx/go-routes.conf keeps them on api_backend at every
# canary percentage. Enrichment/LLM/Redis routes move with plan 05, ingest routes with plan 06. generate-column and provider-accuracy
# moved to internal/api/llmroutes.go in plan 15 WP-LLMROUTES.
POST /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/run
POST /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/stop
POST /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/rows/{row_id}/cells/{col_id}/run
POST /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/sources
POST /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/sources/{col_id}/run
GET /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/sources/{col_id}/preview
POST /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/refresh
PUT /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/refresh-policy
GET /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/run/estimate
POST /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/migrate
GET /api/workbooks/meta/provider-stats
WS /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/ws
POST /api/v2/workbooks/{workbook_id}/ingest-token
POST /api/v2/workbooks/{workbook_id}/rows/ingest
